module: Player "walking" mode: leaving the vehicle spawns a special "unicycle" vehicle (the character) that the player controls on foot; getting back into a nearby vehicle deactivates it. Manages, per player (including multiseat/split screen), the unicycle, its face (face part) and its color, detects the nearest vehicle within 2 m (distance to the edges of its oriented box), shows the "walkingmode" message and exposes a vehicle blacklist. A modder uses it to teleport/place the player, force walking mode or forbid it.
usage:
gameplay_walk.setWalkingMode(true, vec3(x, y, z), quat(0, 0, 0, 1), true) -- forces walking mode at a position
if gameplay_walk.isWalking() then gameplay_walk.getInVehicle(veh) end
gameplay_walk.addVehicleToBlacklist(vehId) -- this vehicle will not be offered for entry
notes: `player` is the player index (0 by default); most functions accept nil and use 0.
The player is "on foot" when their current vehicle has the "unicycle" jbeam file (getCurrentUnicycle).

Toggling: only possible if force, or (parking speed reached and toggling enabled, toggleWalkingMode action not blocked, replay not playing). Speed thresholds: < 5 km/h becomes "stationary", > 6 km/h becomes "moving" (hysteresis).
Emitted hook: onBeforeWalkingModeToggled(enabled, vehId|nil, player) before the change; the UI "Message" (cameramode category) is cleared when entering walking mode.
If gameplay_seatOccupants exists, entering a vehicle goes through requestEnterBestSeat and exiting through getSeatExitData.
A debug dump(config) remains in the code: it writes the config to the logs every time a unicycle is created.
The internal state `active[player]` is only updated by onVehicleSwitched and onDeserialize: setRot does nothing until the player has triggered a vehicle change.

The restore hook is named onDeserialize (not onDeserialized) in this file, while serialization is named onSerialize: possible naming inconsistency depending on what the extension manager calls (not verified here).
onClientEndMission clears the unicycle, face and paint memories; onClientStartMission clears the blacklist and re-enables toggling.

isWalking.desc: Returns whether the player is currently controlling a unicycle.

getCurrentUnicycle.desc: Returns the unicycle the player is controlling right now, whether or not it is the one stored in unicycleIds.

getStoredUnicycleId.desc: Id of the unicycle stored for this player (even if inactive, e.g. while they are driving).

getFacePart.desc: Character face. Priority: unicycle part (parts selector), playerCharacterFace setting (per persona in split screen), last known face, random face.

setFacePart.desc: Changes the face. If the player is on foot, their unicycle is reconfigured; otherwise the stored unicycle is deleted and will be recreated later.

getPaint.desc: Character paint. Priority: persona paint (multiseat), unicycle paint (config menu), last known paint, saved playerCharacterColor color.

isAtParkingSpeed.desc: Returns whether the nearest vehicle (or the player's) is slow enough to allow switching to walking mode.

returns.desc: false only if the speed exceeded 6 km/h without dropping back below 5 km/h.

getDoorsidePosRot.desc: Computes a position near a vehicle's driver door (left or right side depending on the driving side), oriented toward the vehicle's center.

getInVehicle.desc: Makes the player enter a vehicle (be:enterVehicle), storing their current unicycle.

setRot.desc: Orients the camera/on-foot character via the unicycle camera data. Has no effect if the player is not active in walking mode.

canToggleWalkingMode.desc: Returns whether the player can switch modes: force, or parking speed + toggling enabled + action not blocked + no replay playing.

canSetWalkingMode.desc: Like canToggleWalkingMode, but also requires the requested state to differ from the active state.

setWalkingMode.desc: Enables or disables walking mode. On enabling, spawns or reactivates the unicycle at pos (otherwise near the door or at the seat left) and places the player in it. On disabling, enters the nearby vehicle, or simply deactivates the unicycle.

returns.desc: true if the requested state is reached (false if blocked).

toggleWalkingMode.desc: Toggles walking mode (called by the input action). Does nothing if the player is walking with no vehicle nearby; in multiplayer, goes through multiplayer_vehicleSync.

getVehicleInFront.desc: Nearest vehicle (within 2 m) that the on-foot player can enter.

getPosRot.desc: Unicycle position and camera orientation of the on-foot player.

getPosXYZ.desc: Unicycle position as three numbers (no allocation).

returns.desc: x, y, z (nil if the player is not on foot).

getRotXYZW.desc: On-foot player's camera orientation as four numbers.

returns.desc: x, y, z, w (nil if the player is not on foot).

enableToggling.desc: Allows or forbids manual switching between vehicle and walking.

addVehicleToBlacklist.desc: Excludes a vehicle from the candidates for entry in walking mode.

removeVehicleFromBlacklist.desc: Removes a vehicle from the blacklist.

isVehicleBlacklisted.desc: Tests whether a vehicle is in the blacklist.

getBlacklist.desc: Returns the blacklist table (id -> true), not a copy.

onUpdate.desc: Hook called every frame: for each player, looks for the nearby vehicle, updates the parking speed and shows/removes the "walkingmode" message.

onSerialize.desc: Save hook before extensions reload: toggling, blacklist, unicycles, faces, paints.

onDeserialize.desc: Restores the serialized state and recomputes which players are on foot.

onClientStartMission.desc: Hook called at the start of a level: clears the blacklist, re-enables toggling.

onClientEndMission.desc: Hook called at the end of a level: forgets unicycles, faces and paints.

onSplitScreenChanged.desc: Hook called when split screen changes: reconfigures the unicycle colors.

onCameraChanged.desc: Hook called when a player's camera changes: hides the unicycle in the player's view when they use the unicycle camera, or when the big map transition moves away from them.

onVehicleSwitched.desc: Hook called when a player switches vehicle: deactivates the previously stored unicycle and updates the active state.

onVehicleColorChanged.desc: Hook called when a vehicle's color changes: if it is a player's unicycle (outside multiseat), saves the paint in the playerCharacterColor setting.

index.desc: Paint index (only 1 is taken into account).

onVehicleReplaced.desc: Hook called when a vehicle is replaced: forgets the corresponding unicycle.

onVehicleDestroyed.desc: Hook called when a vehicle is destroyed: forgets the corresponding unicycle.
